scope: Full intended project completion, or all machine-resolvable requirements complete with only a proven irreducible external gate.
reasoning_concurrency: purposeful scoped native reviewers and isolated writers authorized
resume_steps: Read the active unrestricted owner override, inspect live ownership, then continue immediately without model/duty restrictions.
Use supported telemetry only at major checkpoints; actual platform failure is a blocker, projected burn is not.
Read the finalized build and later Phase 2 scope specifications and existing acceptance evidence.
Build the requested machine-readable requirement classifications with exact source, receipt, commit and blocking status.
Determine whether real expert labels are mandatory for COMPLETE or only EXPERT_VALIDATED; do not infer this from stale NEXT_ACTION prose.
Execute remaining machine requirements, final package/install checks and adversarial review under the governing policy.
request_hash_scope: Committed UTF-8 request blob; Git normalizes CRLF to LF. Source attachment hash is retained separately.
